source.name: The Movie Database (TMDB)
source.note: Populate with `npm run artwork:fetch` (needs a free TMDB API key in TMDB_API_KEY). Until then the app renders its own generated poster art, so it works fully offline and with no third-party keys. IMDb has no image API and its posters may not be hotlinked, which is why artwork comes from TMDB - keyed by the same IMDb id.
